top_violation_types.title: Sanitize Tables Tops, Furniture and Similar Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407(11))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on interviews with staff and observation of the operation confirms rodent feces present in the classrooms. Rodent feces was seen in vicinity of furniture and children's toys.

top_violation_types.title: No Swaddling of Infant Unless Completed Sleep Exception Form on File (26 TAC §746.2428)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: An infant was observed swaddled in a blanket while being held by a caregiver.

top_violation_types.title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing a child's diaper.
